summaryZh: Sunahara 实验室研究激素与 G 蛋白偶联受体结合后如何启动信号，以及激素结合与 G 蛋白活化之间的变构关系。方法结合生化、生物物理和药理学。
researchQuestions: 激素与 G 蛋白偶联受体结合后，如何引发信号级联活化？
激素结合与 G 蛋白活化之间的变构关系是什么？

evidence.quote: My laboratory primarily focuses on understanding the mechanism by which hormone binding to G protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs) lead to activation of signaling cascades.
My laboratory is keenly interested in the nature of the allosteric relationship between hormone binding and G protein activation. We utilize biochemical, biophysical and pharmacological approaches
